New Crawler

House rules

Play

  • Every move is resolved by the server. Moves need no wallet, no transaction and no AI fee. Sessions have no time cap.
  • Each day the IDSC opens two more floors (depth gate = 3 + 2 × day). At the gate, Overtime Zones keep generating fresh layouts at the same depth.
  • Every Crawler has its own routes, encounters, quests and perk offers, shaped by its history. Reloading never rerolls anything.

Death, resets and persistence

  • Death is permanent for that character. It goes to the Hall of Corpses with its fame intact.
  • Kept across deaths: your account, cosmetics, slots, Elevator Pass (new Crawlers start at half your season-best depth), and every reward you have already earned.
  • Seasons reset depth and leaderboards. Your account and purchases carry over.
  • Saves are on the server, so any device you sign in on picks up where you left off. Guests get a recovery code; a linked wallet works too.

Items, purchases and ownership

  • In-game items and gold live on the server ledger. They are not tokens and can't be traded for money.
  • The DCP shop sells only cosmetics, slots, and Revives. A revived run cannot win leaderboard prizes, so buying one never buys rank.
  • An item is credited only once its purchase is final onchain. Of each purchase, 30% is burned, 50% goes back to the prize reserve and 20% funds operations.

Token prizes

  • Prizes are small and capped: milestones the first time you reach certain depths each season, the top ten daily fame gains, and a daily weighted draw.
  • To receive prizes you need a linked wallet, an account at least a day old and real play. Accounts that share a device or network split a single account's cap.
  • This build uses simulated draws and test DCP only. A later launch requires funded, verified randomness and independent score review. No real prizes are enabled here.
  • There is no yield, return or service guarantee. Final contract claims are designed to remain claimable without operators; pending off-chain awards still depend on settlement and published proofs.

Sign-in safety

  • Connecting a wallet doesn't sign you in. You sign a one-time message that costs no gas and approves nothing.
  • If you switch accounts or networks in your wallet, you'll be asked to sign again.
· Original world & cast. Not affiliated with any book, show or meme rights holder. No anonymity is claimed: onchain actions are public.
